title: The settings.json allow entry "Merge Tool Read Checks" says merge --reviewed only reads, but after #3148 it also posts a marker and sends mail
why: Coordinator 11:26 CST Nov 13: the autoMode.allow entry "Merge Tool Read Checks" claims `merge --reviewed` only reads; after #3148 it also posts a lane-mail marker and sends mail in a batch-runner session. An allow entry that misdescribes an act is a guard that lies.
source: coordinator 11:26 CST Nov 13; reviewer finding 9 on #3148
note: Rewrite the entry to say what the command does now. Queue behind #3148, which changes the behaviour. It changes a guard's allow list, so it goes to a lane and a reviewer. Owner 11:45 CST Nov 13, item 709 a: accepted. Lane mail from `merge --reviewed` sends only in a batch-runner session; an owner-machine run prints "lane mail not sent". The allow text must say so.
